issues.title: Retry can double-charge
issues.explanation: A timeout does not mean the charge failed. Retrying charges.create without an idempotency key can charge the card again.
issues.fix: Pass idempotencyKey derived from the cart (e.g. `checkout-${cartId}`) on every attempt.

issues.title: Declines are retried
issues.explanation: The catch retries every error, including card declines, which PAY-51 says must fail immediately. There is also no delay between attempts.
issues.fix: Retry only on timeout/network errors; rethrow declines at once; add a short backoff.

issues.title: Double submit or failed insert
issues.explanation: Two concurrent checkouts for the same cart both charge. If orders.insert fails after the charge, the customer pays with no order.
issues.fix: Lock or mark the cart as checking out first; record a pending order before charging and reconcile on failure.

issues.title: Money summed as floats
issues.explanation: Summing decimal dollars in floating point can drift by a cent before Math.round.
issues.fix: Keep prices in integer cents end to end.
